headline: Discussed small summer and fall events, a future concert, projector rentals, Poutine fest, Rib fest, and an ice rink at Holman Stadium.
summary: No public comment was made. Members discussed ideas for small events this summer and fall, a future concert, projector rentals, a Hot Sheet of restaurants and bars, and an ice rink. No votes or other decisions are recorded.

Holman Stadium Activation Committee Minutes – June 23, 2026 
 
 
Holman Stadium Activation Committee 
Public Meeting MINUTES 
 July 14, 2026, 3:00 pm 
Mayor's Suite at  
Holman Stadium 
  
 
Attendees: 
Commissioner Paul Shea - Chairman 
Alderman Amber Morgan  
Commissioner June Lemen 
Grant Morris 
Assistant Director Matt Leblanc 
Superintendent Bryan Conant  
Cam Cook – Silver Knights  
Director Liz Hannum 
  
Commissioner Manny Espitia – Absent  
Alyssa O’Mara - Absent 
 
 
Call to Order: 3:00 pm  
 
Public Comment – No public comment 
 
Current Business 
 
Paul Shea 
 – Adding Sandy Belknap, Cam Cook 
Matt Leblanc 
 – Discussed starting this doing something small to start the summer/fall and

Holman Stadium Activation Committee Minutes – June 23, 2026 
 
Bryan

Liz and Cam

Paul 
 – Asking Grant to keep pushing ice rink here at Holman for hockey  
 
 
NEXT Meeting August 4th 3:00 PM, Holman Stadium, Mayor’s Suite  
 
Adjournment
